name: Mapa de Resolución de Video
description: Mapea la resolución del video para detectar regiones manipuladas
algorithm: Video Resolution Map — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method creates resolution maps for video deepfake detection:

1. **Local Resolución Estimación**: Effective spatial resolution is estimated locally using edge sharpness analysis, modulation transfer function (MTF) estimation, and texture detail measurements. This creates a per-region resolution map revealing where the image is effectively sharp vs. degraded.

2. **Resolución Consistencia Check**: Resolution across the frame should follow the camera's optical characteristics: uniform within the depth of field, decreasing with distance from the focal plane, potentially soft at frame corners (lens vignetting). The method checks for consistency. Deepfakes may show a face with different effective resolution than the background.

3. **Resolución Límite Detección**: The method detects boundaries between regions of different effective resolution. Abrupt resolution changes not corresponding to depth boundaries indicate compositing — where a generated face (at the generator's output resolution) meets original footage (at the camera's capture resolution).

4. **Upsampling/Downsampling Detección**: The method detects evidence of resolution changes — interpolation artifacts from upsampling (ringing, aliasing) or detail loss from downsampling. These artifacts indicate the content has been resized, consistent with deepfake pipelines that generate at one resolution and resize to match the target video.

5. **Temporal Resolución Estabilidad**: Effective resolution should remain stable across frames for static content. The method tracks resolution maps over time — deepfake generation may produce temporally varying effective resolution as the generator's output detail fluctuates frame-to-frame.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante video resolution map analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
